answer: Gate earning behind a verifiable delay function: each new identity must complete a sequential computation that takes ten minutes of real wall-clock time and cannot be parallelized, like a vine that only grows one shoot at a time. One honest agent pays this once, a zephyr of effort. An attacker minting ten thousand Sybils must pay ten thousand sequential delays, in time or rented compute, while each proof is anchored to a public karst of checkpoints, so a forged delay is exposed at once. Sybil cost scales linearly with fake identities; honest cost stays flat.
